description: Canonical vocabulary for human responses to built environment

terms.name: Broad Attention
terms.definition: Awareness of multiple environmental stimuli simultaneously

terms.name: Cognitive Load
terms.definition: Mental effort required to process environmental information

terms.name: Creativity
terms.definition: Generation of novel ideas and solutions

terms.name: Executive Function
terms.definition: Higher-order control of thought and action

terms.name: Place Recognition
terms.definition: Ability to identify and remember locations

terms.name: Spatial Cognition
terms.definition: Mental representation and reasoning about space

terms.name: Aesthetic Pleasure
terms.definition: Positive response to beauty and visual harmony

terms.name: Awe
terms.definition: Profound emotion of wonder and majesty

terms.name: Being Away
terms.definition: Psychological distance from routine demands and mental fatigue sources

terms.name: Compatibility
terms.definition: Perceived fit between environmental affordances and individual purposes or inclinations

terms.name: Extent
terms.definition: Sense of being in a richly connected, coherent whole — a whole other world

terms.name: Fascination
terms.definition: Effortless attention capture by environmental features

terms.name: Mystery
terms.definition: Promise of further information if one explores deeper

terms.name: Place Attachment
terms.definition: Emotional bond between person and place

terms.name: Environmental Preference
terms.definition: Overall evaluative judgment of environmental desirability

terms.name: Emotional Resilience
terms.definition: Ability to recover from emotional distress

terms.name: Perceived Restorativeness
terms.definition: Subjective experience of mental resource recovery

terms.name: Perceived Safety
terms.definition: Subjective sense of security in an environment

terms.name: Dwell Time
terms.definition: Duration of voluntary staying in a location

terms.name: Engagement
terms.definition: Level of involvement and focused attention

terms.name: Exploration Behavior
terms.definition: Voluntary movement and investigation of environments

terms.name: Risk Taking
terms.definition: Tendency to engage in risky behavior

terms.name: Wayfinding Performance
terms.definition: Ability to navigate through built environments

terms.name: Affiliation
terms.definition: Sense of belonging and group identity
operationalizations: Inclusion of Other in Self Scale (IOS)

terms.name: Sense of Belonging
terms.definition: Feeling of being accepted and included in a place

terms.name: Privacy
terms.definition: Control over personal information and social access

terms.name: Arousal
terms.definition: Level of physiological and psychological activation

terms.name: Thermal Comfort
terms.definition: Perception and experience of environmental temperature

terms.name: Default Mode Network Activity
terms.definition: Activity in DMN during environmental experience

terms.name: Neural Reward Response
terms.definition: Activation of reward circuits to environmental stimuli

terms.name: Circadian Health
terms.definition: Alignment of biological rhythms with environmental light

terms.name: Resilience
terms.definition: Capacity to bounce back from adversity

terms.name: Sick Building Symptoms
terms.definition: Health symptoms attributed to building environment

terms.name: Air Quality
terms.definition: Perception and objective measures of air quality

terms.name: Environmental Coherence
terms.definition: Orderliness and unity of environmental composition

terms.name: Enclosure
terms.definition: Degree to which space is bounded by vertical surfaces

terms.name: Legibility
terms.definition: Ease of understanding and forming a mental map of spatial organization

terms.name: Lighting Quality
terms.definition: Light levels and color quality perception

terms.name: Materiality
terms.definition: Tactile and material properties of surfaces

terms.name: Natural Features
terms.definition: Presence and visibility of natural elements

terms.name: Perceived Naturalness
terms.definition: Degree to which environment is perceived as natural versus artificial

terms.name: Noise
terms.definition: Sound level and acoustic quality perception

terms.name: Perceived Environmental Control
terms.definition: Sense of control over environmental conditions such as lighting, temperature, and noise

terms.name: Privacy
terms.definition: Control and protection from unwanted observation

terms.name: Prospect-Refuge
terms.definition: Balance of openness and enclosure in space

terms.name: Visual Access
terms.definition: Extent of unobstructed visual field in environment

terms.name: Openness
terms.definition: Perceived openness and spaciousness of environments

terms.name: Perceived Hazard
terms.definition: Perceived danger and risk in built environments

terms.name: Water Features
terms.definition: Presence and quality of water elements in environments

terms.name: Glare
terms.definition: Discomfort or disability glare from light sources
